description:

Record the owner-approved Wheel scope from research record 046 (research/summary/046.md, origin/046.md) in this repository: Wheel is the official Agent Harness plugin for the Bitty terminal scoped to software engineering only (Coding domain fixed; roles Primary/Commander/Coding/Review/Debug/Research vary inside it; staged MVP single Primary -> Primary+Subagents -> Commander). Cite research 046 as provenance; English-only.

Out of scope: any harness code, manifest/capability changes, staged MVP work, LLM-provider split (tracked separately in bitty-ai-docs from research 047). Stop at review; do NOT commit, push, or open PRs.
